name: Ministry of Manpower

scam_info.sample: Some fake websites that we found are: "http://www.mom-sg.org" "http://mom-gov.com" "http://ministryofmanpower.net" "http://wponlinemomgov.sg.com"
scam_info.notes: Fake-site examples (6, text, not visited): mom-sg.org, mom-gov.com, ministryofmanpower.net, wponlinemomgov.sg.com, 'www.mom.gov.sg@211.239.150.170', 'www.mom.gov.sg.official.com.net'. ALSO official channels (a): 'Official MOM websites and eServices' URLs will always contain ".mom.gov.sg"' e.g. www/services/wponline.mom.gov.sg; MOM emails from MOM domain or PostmanSG; gov.sg SMS sender ID. Last updated 23 January 2026 (= latest_item_date). Sitemap child file inferred by sitemap index listing (sitemap.xml index -> others.xml); exact child containing this URL not checked.

scam_info.sample: Scam alert: Spoofed emails on “Declaration of Payment for April 2022 Salaries for all Workers / Migrant workers” ... fake emails from a spoofed MOM email address (mom_lrwd_nr@mom.gov.sg).
scam_info.notes: Series of 27 'scam-alert' announcements in newsroom.xml (2,923 newsroom URLs, lastmod present), 2019-09-17 .. 2025-07-08, URL pattern /newsroom/announcements/<YYYY>/<MMDD>-scam-alert[...]. Some name spoofed sender addresses (e.g. 2022/0523: mom_lrwd_nr@mom.gov.sg; title says mom_rsd@mom.gov.sg) -> lists_indicators=email (spoofed). Newest (8 Jul 2025) is narrative impersonation-call alert. Old ones cite anti-scam helpline 1800 722 6688 and scamalert.sg (now 301 to scamshield). Sample from 2022/0523-scam-alert.

scam_info.sample: Scams can happen to anyone, including Migrant Domestic Workers (MDWs). Learn how MDWs can recognise and avoid scams, while safeguarding their well-being and hard-earned money.
scam_info.notes: MDW-focused scam guide (types, real stories, ACT posters in Bahasa Indonesia/Burmese/Hindi/Tagalog/Tamil). Narrative. Last updated 2 July 2026.

scam_info.sample: EA Alert: Advisory on Fraudulent Actions by Employment Agencies in Work Pass Applications
scam_info.notes: Dated table of EA Alerts (2014-2026; many PDFs) for licensed employment agencies; scam-relevant items include 'EA Alert: Report suspected unlicensed employment agents' (8 Jun 2026), 'Fake job postings' advisories. Mostly regulatory, low IOC value. machine_url: page is in sitemap index (child not pinned).
